Appointment command now enforces workspace minimum lead time, maximum advance window and multi-day policy using workspace timezone. Added explicit transactional work-order creation with tenant/customer/vehicle/appointment/location invariants, per-workspace advisory-locked numbering, and work_order.created event. summary: Implemented public booking plus technician inspection/job-completion lifecycle on the unified Next.js branch. Public booking resolves workspace by booking_slug server-side, exposes active services, enforces contact/lead-time/advance/conflict rules, atomically creates/reuses customer + vehicle + appointment, stores selected service in appointment metadata, and publishes appointment.created to the transactional outbox. Work-order creation now carries that booked service into a canonical line item. Existing production inspection/service-record tables were mapped into Drizzle with no DDL. Technicians can start jobs, complete required inspection templates, persist inspection results transactionally, and complete jobs only after all service-required inspections are completed; completion updates work order, appointment, service record, and publishes work_order.completed.
evidence: production Supabase rjfbrfognxqkyhdrpibx inspection/service-record schema verification
schema_policy: No migration created. Existing inspection_templates, inspection_items, service_inspections, inspection_results, service_recommendations, and service_records remain authoritative.
notification_state: Booking and job lifecycle events are published durably to domain_events/event_deliveries. Provider-specific email/SMS consumers are not falsely marked complete here.

summary: Implemented server-owned workspace Settings plus durable notification/outbox processing. Added business/profile/booking/pricing/terms settings UI and role-gated Server Action updates. Production verification proved the outbox tables were missing, so an additive production migration created domain_events, event_deliveries, and event_consumer_executions with workspace-scoped idempotency, RLS enabled, browser roles revoked, lease/retry/dead-letter fields, and indexes. Added a FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED worker with stale-lease recovery, exponential retry, dead-lettering, idempotent customer-email consumer execution, Resend delivery, and protected internal drain/status endpoints. Supported customer-email events: appointment.created, work_order.completed, quote.sent, invoice.issued, payment.succeeded.
security_state: Outbox tables have RLS enabled and anon/authenticated privileges revoked. Supabase advisor reports RLS-enabled/no-policy INFO for these internal tables, which is intentional because they are server-only.
runtime_configuration: RESEND_API_KEY, RESEND_FROM_EMAIL, and CRON_SECRET are required in the eventual deployment. The branch intentionally does not hard-code a Vercel cron cadence because current Vercel Hobby cron is once daily while Pro/Enterprise supports per-minute execution; scheduler cadence must match the deployment plan at cutover.
verification: Outbox production schema and rollback-only lifecycle probe verified. Branch typecheck/lint/build remain UNVERIFIED until an executable CI or deployment runner is available.

summary: Executed production-schema and rollback-only lifecycle certification for the unified Next.js/Hono branch. Passed cross-workspace FK isolation, workspace-scoped outbox idempotency, core seeded lifecycle customer→vehicle→appointment→work order→service line→quote→invoice→payment→outbox, outbox RLS/privilege lock-down, required inspection template resolution, inspection service-record FK linkage, and inspection completion lookup. Certification surfaced and fixed three real production mismatches: work_orders.number and invoices.invoice_number are GENERATED ALWAYS identities and must not be manually inserted; service_inspections.service_id references service_records.id rather than service_catalog.id; inspection_results.status is constrained to good/attention/urgent/not_applicable/not_checked rather than pass/warning/fail. The branch was updated accordingly.
